subject.cedVersion: AP U.S. Government and Politics CED (Course Framework V.1, (c)2026; 2027 exam: fully digital, 55 MC/80 min, 4 FRQ/100 min)
subject.designNotes: 5 units with weights, topic codes/titles and class periods (full-year/semester) from the posted CED (read 2026-10-20). Exam: fully digital; Section I 55 MC, 80 min, 50% (about 30 individual plus sets: 5 quantitative sets of 2-3, 2 text-based sets of 3-4 questions); Section II 4 FRQ, 100 min, 50% (Q1 Concept Application 3 pts/20 min, Q2 Quantitative Analysis 4 pts/20 min, Q3 SCOTUS Comparison 4 pts/20 min, Q4 Argument Essay 6 pts/40 min). No calculator. AP Central notes four additional required foundational documents for 2026-27. Skills are the 5 skill categories at category level; the required Supreme Court cases and foundational documents are referenced by name in a few sub-keywords. Skill weights not recorded. Per-topic and per-sub-keyword skills are an ALTON editorial mapping (one skill per sub-keyword chosen by kind and content), not the CED's per-topic suggested skills. Sub-keywords, kinds, requires and estLessons are ALTON editorial designs, not CED content. Topic titles are the CED's where read from the CED course-at-a-glance; where the extracted text was truncated they are close paraphrases.
